title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Revelation 11: the measuring of the temple, the two witnesses and the seventh trumpet.

questions.text: What was given to the narrator at the beginning of the chapter?
questions.explanation: A reed like a rod was given to him, and someone said, “Rise, and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.”

questions.text: For how long will the nations tread the holy city under foot?
questions.explanation: The court outside the temple was given to the nations, and they will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

questions.text: How were the two witnesses clothed while they prophesied?
questions.explanation: The two witnesses were given power to prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.

questions.text: What does the text call the two witnesses?
questions.explanation: They are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

answers.text: The two angels of the abyss
The two beasts of the earth
The two olive trees and the two lamp stands

questions.text: What power do the two witnesses have over the sky?
questions.explanation: They have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy, and power over the waters to turn them into blood.

answers.text: To shut it up so that it does not rain
To roll it up like a scroll
To make fire come down from it
To darken the sun and the moon

questions.text: Who makes war with the two witnesses and kills them?
questions.explanation: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, overcome them and kill them.

answers.text: The beast that comes up out of the abyss

questions.text: What happened to the two witnesses after the three and a half days?
questions.explanation: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell on those who saw them.

answers.text: Their dead bodies were laid in a tomb at last
Their bodies were burned with fire in the street
They were carried away into the wilderness
The breath of life from God entered them and they stood up

questions.text: How many people were killed in the great earthquake?
questions.explanation: There was a great earthquake, a tenth of the city fell, and seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake.

questions.text: When the seventh angel sounded, what did the great voices in heaven say the kingdom of the world had become?
questions.explanation: They said, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

answers.text: The Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ
The kingdom of the beast and his image
The city of the nations for forty-two months
The dwelling of the dragon and his angels

questions.text: What was seen when God’s temple in heaven was opened?
questions.explanation: God’s temple in heaven was opened and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple, and lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake and great hail followed.

answers.text: A sea of glass mixed with fire
A woman clothed with the sun
The ark of the Lord’s covenant
